symptom: An older VERIFIED_SUCCESS guardrail could be reused even after a newer NEW_FAILURE for the same normalized attempt.
lesson: Observational records must not hide a reusable success, but a newer unchanged failure for the same normalized identity must supersede an older success guardrail.
guardrail: Order decisive learning by time within the full normalized identity: reuse VERIFIED_SUCCESS only when it is newer than any unchanged failure; otherwise apply the one/two-failure switch/block gate since the latest verified success.
